FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Clear answers for
confident decisions.

Everything you need to know about preparing plans, turnaround times, client sharing, and architectural accuracy.

01What drawing files can I upload?+

We accept PDF blueprints, DWG or DXF CAD files, vector schematics, and high-resolution photos of hand-drawn floor plans up to 50 MB. Each allocation credit covers one complete residential apartment or standalone architectural structure.

Project note: Our project-start portal validates your files locally and generates a structured client brief.

02Do clients need to install any apps or software?+

No software or plugin installation is ever required. The walkthrough runs directly inside Safari, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or any modern web browser on iPhones, Android phones, iPads, tablets, and laptops.

Project note: Built with lightweight WebGL and Three.js for seamless, high-framerate interactive spatial viewing.

03Can I embed the walkthrough on my studio portfolio website?+

Yes. You receive a clean, responsive HTML iframe embed snippet that works in Webflow, Squarespace, WordPress, Framer, or custom-coded websites. You can also self-host the files on your own domain.

Project note: Preview and copy the responsive iframe code directly on the Delivery page.

04How accurate are the spatial dimensions and wall heights?+

Archivue models every space strictly adhering to the dimensional annotations in your supplied plans. We verify wall boundaries, door swings, and window placements before three-dimensional assembly begins.

Project note: The Courtyard Residence concept features standard 190 mm structural walls with 2.8 m interior clear ceiling height.

05Can we customize interior materials, finishes, and furniture?+

Yes. Studio Suite and Enterprise Practice packages include dedicated styling revision rounds. Specify your preferred flooring materials, millwork colors, and furniture arrangements in your project brief.

Project note: The included parametric JavaScript model source also allows full programmatic geometry adjustments.

06Do project credits or packages ever expire?+

No. Project credits never expire. Purchase a package today and utilize your allocations across upcoming client commissions throughout the year.

Project note: Reference studio pricing. Brief export generates full project specifications ready for commissioning.
